name: altimate-code
description: Gives Claude Code altimate-code's model-free data tools (column-level lineage, impact analysis, PII detection, data-diff, FinOps, query equivalence, dialect translation, warehouse queries) through its MCP server, or through `altimate tool run` when MCP servers are not allowed, with delegation to the altimate-code agent for long dbt jobs, access to a linked Altimate workspace's knowledge, and the workspace's team rules in each session.

dbt_mods.title: dbt helpers
dbt_mods.description: Compile and validate each model Claude edits, Explain and Fix on a failed dbt run, the Query results pane, model context on read, and the dbt environment doctor at session start. They run the project's own dbt. Optional; default: on.

maxScanBytes.title: Largest dbt scan without asking
maxScanBytes.description: A dbt run, build or show estimated to scan more bytes than this is held until you approve it with /allow-scan; 0 never holds. Scans are estimated on BigQuery only, by its dry run. A query with no estimate, and any other warehouse, is never held. Optional; default: 10737418240 (10 GiB).

healthBlocksPush.title: Project health blocks git push
healthBlocksPush.description: On refuses a git push while the project health check finds new issues in the models you changed this session, and while the check cannot run or has not finished; off only shows them. Optional; default: off.

healthConfigPath.title: Project health check config
healthConfigPath.description: Path to a DataPilot health check config file, relative to the dbt project. Optional; default: empty, which uses the default checks.

commentsPollSeconds.title: Team comments refresh (seconds)
commentsPollSeconds.description: How often, in seconds, the team's comments on shared docs are fetched again in an interactive session (30 to 86400). Optional; default: 900.

commentsInContext.title: Team comments in Claude's context
commentsInContext.description: When on, the open team comments on a model Claude reads or edits are added to its context; off keeps them out of Claude's context. Optional; default: on.

show_edit_impact.title: Show edit impact notes
show_edit_impact.description: When on, the note on what a model edit reaches downstream (read by N models, dashboards) is also shown in the transcript; off sends it to Claude and the debug log only. Optional; default: off.
